title: Who Gets Re-ranked When a Clinical Model Gains New Data?
abstract: arXiv:2611.28968v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hospitals often update a deployed risk model by adding a data source, such as laboratory results, that only some patients have. Work on safe model updates assumes fixed inputs and so ignores patients who lack the new data. The update has no new measurements for them, yet their rank can change, and a sick patient not yet tested can drop off an alert list. We split rank-based compatibility by data availability and pair it with error correction and alert-list effects. We compared each update with ordinary retraining on the old inputs, predicting ICU admission or death and hospital admission, on 78,475 emergency department visits from MC-MED and, in a pre-registered replication, 100,000 stays from MIMIC-IV-ED at a second hospital. Radiograph report text gave no detectable gain and almost no extra re-ranking. Laboratory results improved prediction but, at both hospitals and with linear or tree models, pushed patients without labs down alert

translated_title: 当临床模型获得新数据时，谁会被重新排序？
translated_abstract: 医院通常会通过添加一个数据源（例如只有部分患者才有的实验室检测结果）来更新已部署的风险模型。关于安全模型更新的现有研究假设输入是固定的，因此忽略了缺乏新数据的患者。模型更新对这些患者没有新的测量值，但他们的排名仍可能发生变化，一位尚未接受检测的危重患者可能会从警报名单中掉落。我们按数据可用性拆分了基于排名的兼容性，并将其与误差校正和警报名单效应相结合。我们在来自 MC-MED 的 78,475 次急诊科就诊数据上，以及在第二家医院 MIMIC-IV-ED 的 100,000 次住院记录的预注册重复实验中，将每种更新方式与在旧输入上进行普通重训练进行了比较，任务为预测 ICU 入院或死亡以及医院入院。结果显示，放射报告文本没有带来可检测的增益，也几乎没有引起额外的重新排序；实验室结果改善了预测，但在两家医院、无论采用线性模型还是树模型的情况下，都把没有实验室结果的患者推向了警报名单的更下方（注：原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文研究了医院临床风险模型添加新数据源（如实验室结果）时缺乏新数据的患者如何被重新排序，发现实验室结果虽能改善预测，却会使未经检测的危重患者在两家医院的不同模型中都下降到警报名单的更低位置。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates how patients lacking a newly added data source are re-ranked when a deployed clinical risk model is updated, showing that laboratory results improve prediction but push untested patients down alert lists across two hospitals and multiple model types.
